questions.question: What does ERR-4032 mean and what is the fix?
questions.known_answer: The stored payment token came from the legacy vault and has no provider-side equivalent. Fix: have the customer re-add the payment method, then re-run the migration for that workspace only using 'Retry failed instruments' - not the full workspace migration.

questions.question: Reconciliation found a rounding difference above one cent on an invoice. What should I do?
questions.known_answer: ERR-4217. File a reconciliation ticket; do not adjust the invoice by hand because hand adjustments break the cutover backfill.
must_contain: Do not adjust the invoice by hand

questions.question: Our client gets a 409 idempotency_reuse error on the billing API after migrating. What is the documented fix?
questions.known_answer: ERR-4111: the idempotency key was reused within the workspace in the last 24 hours. Fix: generate a fresh UUID per logical operation and retry; do not derive the key from a request hash.
must_contain: Do not derive the key from a request hash

questions.question: A customer's tax ID failed revalidation. What is the fix?
questions.known_answer: ERR-4501. Ask the customer to confirm the ID, correct it if wrong, then re-run the backfill with --force-tax-refresh. CAVEAT that lives in prose, not in the row: the tax cache has a hard 24-hour TTL, so a re-run before the entry expires silently no-ops and looks identical to a second genuine failure.

questions.question: How long does a workspace have to stay in the dual-write phase, and can support waive it?
questions.known_answer: Minimum seven days. The seven-day floor is not configurable by support and cannot be waived by an account manager.

questions.question: What happens to a subscription whose billing anchor is the 31st after it migrates during a short month?
questions.known_answer: v2 clamps permanently, so it stays anchored to the 28th or 29th for every subsequent period. Restoring the original anchor needs a support action and cannot be done from the customer-facing UI.
must_contain: cannot be done from the customer-facing UI

questions.question: A customer's card expires next month. Does that block their billing migration?
questions.known_answer: No. Cards expiring within 30 days are deliberately skipped, listed as 'deferred_expiring', and the customer is emailed a card-update link. A skipped card does not block the migration and needs no ticket.

questions.question: A customer got a credit note during dual-write and their v2 totals now look too high. Should we issue another credit note?
questions.gold_section: Credit notes are the common surprise
questions.known_answer: No. Credit notes are not copied hourly, so v2 totals read high until cutover; the difference resolves itself at cutover. Issuing a second credit note creates a real double credit that has to be clawed back manually.
must_contain: Do not issue a second credit note
